summary: Institutional positioning is heavily focused on long-term volatility hedging and extreme tail-risk positioning, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 8000P (exp 2026-09-18) and SPX 7000C (exp 2026-09-18). There is significant directional conviction in the semiconductor and tech sectors, specifically with aggressive call buying in AMD ($101.6M), NVDA ($101.4M), and META ($116.8M), alongside a massive $378.1M call sweep in CRM. Persistent institutional interest is clearly visible in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-09-18) which has accumulated $6.9B over the last four sessions, signaling a massive, multi-day bet on long-term index expansion. Traders should watch for continued volatility in SPX as the market balances massive long-dated call accumulation against heavy put buying in the 8000 strike, suggesting a "strangle" approach to extreme market moves.
